get.description: Returns at most 20 accounts (id, type, status, owner name) and never a balance. A whole UUID finds that account; anything else is a case-insensitive partial match on the owner name (% and _ are plain characters). Every valid lookup, even an empty one, is audited before the answer is returned; the audit row keeps the operator, the number of results and an account id or a SHA-256 fingerprint of the name, never the name.

post.description: Atomically locks a customer account (status = LOCKED), revokes the owner active sessions (users.sessions_revoked_at = clock_timestamp()), writes a fail-closed audit row, and emits AccountStatusChanged in one transaction. Never returns a balance and never exposes the lock reason in events or customer responses (BR-13).

post.summary: Operator: deposit from SYSTEM funding with atomic double entry

post.description: Source must belong to caller. Checks, in order under the account lock: both accounts ACTIVE, per-transfer limit, per-day limit (Vietnam time), enough money; the first rule broken is the reason. Idempotent: the same key with the same body returns the first answer without a second transfer; the same key with another body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
